title: feat(app-shell): grouped, complete flow add-node palette
body:
## What

Dogfooding the flow designer: the quick-add palette listed 12 node types as a flat list, and `assignment` / `screen` / `delete_record` / the parallel gateways could only be reached by adding a node and switching its type in the inspector — real friction when building flows.

- **Complete** — the palette now offers **Delete record**, **Set variables** (assignment), **Screen**, **Parallel split** and **Parallel join** too, so every common node type is one click away.
- **Grouped** — items are organised into **Data / Logic / Human / Integration / Flow** sections with headers + dividers, so the (now longer) list stays scannable. A new `nodeCategory(type)` helper drives the grouping (mirrors the `nodeTone` families) and gives engine-only / plugin-contributed types a sensible section; `mergePalette` preserves a base item's category and infers one for engine-only descriptors.

Builds on the merged designer polish (#1430).

## Verification

In-browser (Studio → flow → designer, dark + light): the grouped palette renders all sections with tinted icon chips; adding a newly-offered type (e.g. Parallel split) drops a node onto the canvas with the correct icon/tone (amber GitFork) and **no overlap**. `mergePalette` unit tests updated — **6 passing**; `tsc --noEmit` clean on `@object-ui/app-shell`.
